metadata.name: AM-GUI
metadata.summary: Manage, install, and update AppImages and portable packages with an intuitive interface

content.value: AM-GUI is a graphical frontend designed to simplify managing AppImages and other portable application formats on Linux. Built with modern web technologies using Electron and powered by the AM package manager engine, it provides an accessible desktop application store experience for standalone software.
By wrapping the AM and appman command-line utilities, AM-GUI offers an intuitive way to discover software, maintain software libraries, and handle updates across a wide range of Linux distributions.

items.value: Search and discover portable Linux software catalogs directly from a visual store
Install, reinstall, and remove applications with one-click package operations
Seamless system desktop integration for standalone packages and AppImages
Check for updates and manage versions of installed portable software
Support for both light and dark visual themes to match desktop preferences
